ops.text: 7.7 No liquidated damages and no penalty are payable by Customer under this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept liquidated damages or penalties payable by us, and 15% of annual Fees per week for a ten-day payment delay would exceed the contract value within weeks. We have deleted that charge and replaced it with a one-sentence prohibition, leaving Vendor's other late-payment remedies and the Section 7.3 interest position untouched.
proposal.summary: Delete the Customer-payable liquidated damages charge in 7.7 and replace it with a prohibition on Customer-payable liquidated damages and penalties

mappings.element: No liquidated damages payable by Customer.
